description: This file defines the MetadataBubblingUrlGenerator class, which decorates a URL generator to bubble URL metadata within Drupal's rendering system. It implements methods for context management, URL generation, and metadata bubbling, facilitating decoupled routing and rendering.

classes.name: MetadataBubblingUrlGenerator
classes.description: A decorator class for URL generation that bubbles bubbleable metadata in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the URL generator and renderer dependencies.

methods.name: setContext
methods.description: Sets the request context for the URL generator.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Retrieves the current request context from the URL generator.

methods.name: getPathFromRoute
methods.description: Returns a URL path for a given route name and parameters.

methods.name: bubble
methods.description: Bubbles metadata from a GeneratedUrl object to the current render context if available.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a URL for a route, bubbles metadata, and returns the URL string.

methods.name: generateFromRoute
methods.description: Generates a URL from route parameters, optionally bubbles metadata, and returns URL or string.
